Enterprise Sales Executive Job at Cobranet Limited




        
    

        
        Cobranet Limited; a reputable organization incorporated in 2003 and provides internet solutions. Our footprint and range of products have grown immensely since incorporation and we are proud to provide every segment of society with a reliable link to the digital universe.

Our entire network topology is rugged, dynamic and fully redundant with negligible downtimes: content showing extremely high availability exceeding 99.5%. Our promise is to continue providing innovative solutions at the best feature-to-price and service-to-price ratio.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Enterprise Sales Executive

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time
     

            
    



Job Summary


	We are looking for a high-performing Snr. Sales Executive to help us meet our customer acquisition and revenue growth targets by keeping our company competitive and innovative.
	You will be responsible for maximizing our sales potential, crafting sales plans, and justifying those plans to upper management.


Responsibilities


	Prospecting for new sales and opportunities
	 Achieving growth and hitting sales targets by successfully managing available resources
	Designing and implementing a strategic business/sales plan that expands the company’s customer base and ensure it’s strong presence
	Build and promote strong, long-lasting customer relationships by partnering with them and understanding their needs
	Present sales, revenue, and expenses reports and realistic forecasts to the management team
	Identify emerging markets and market shifts while being fully aware of new products and competition status
	Ensure the adequacy of sales-related equipment or material
	Respond to complaints from customers and give after-sales support when requested
	Store and sort financial and non-financial data in electronic form and present reports
	Handle the processing of all orders with accuracy and timeliness
	Inform clients of unforeseen delays or problems
	Manage customer portfolio to maximize relationship building opportunities.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or a Master's Degree in Business Administration or a related field; certification in sales or marketing will be an asset
	Minimum of 3 years of work experience
	Successful previous experience as a sales representative, consistently meeting or exceeding targets
	Committed to continuous education through workshops, seminars and conferences
	Demonstrated ability to communicate, present and influence credibly and effectively at all levels of the organization
	Proven ability to drive the sales process from plan to close
	Strong business sense and industry expertise
	Excellent mentoring, coaching and people management skills
	Proven working experience as a project administrator in the information technology sector
	Solid technical background, with understanding or hands-on experience in software development and web technologies
	Excellent verbal and communication skills with proficiency in the English Language
	Solid organizational skills, including attention to detail and multitasking skills
	Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office
	Well-organized and responsible with an aptitude in problem-solving
	A team player with a high level of dedication


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send CVs to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the email subject.

Note: Only qualified candidates will be contacted.

Marketing Manager Job at Tom Salem Integrated Services Limited




        
    

        
        Tom Salem Integrated Services Ltd is a Security service company that offers contract guards to clients for private properties, banks, hotels, private companies, and individuals, and private occasions needing security services. We have been in the business of securing lives and property for clients for years and our services speak for themselves.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Marketing Manager

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are in need of a General Manager (Marketing) at a car dealership.
	Creates and executes promotional strategies to drive sales, boost showroom traffic, and build brand loyalty
	Track and optimize incoming customer leads and pass to the sales team
	Manage the dealership social media channels
	Monitor lead generation
	Vendor and media relations
	Monitor online reviews, customer feedbacks, and public relations to maintain a strong local brand


Skills and Qualifications


	Minimum HND in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field
	3 - 5 years of proven marketing experience, experience within the automotive industry will be an advantage
	Date driven thinking, ceative communication and local awareness.


Pay Structure


	Salary: N250,000 - N350,000 / month.
	Base salary plus commission/bonus plan.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Marketing Manager" as the subject of the email.

  "description": "Begi Clean Limited is a professional cleaning and facility support company committed to delivering high-quality, reliable, and efficient cleaning solutions to corporate organizations, institutions, and commercial clients.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Operations &amp; Client Relationship Officer

Job Location: Lawanson, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Operations and Client Satisfaction Officer to oversee daily operational activities while ensuring an excellent client experience.
	The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between internal processes and client needs, resolving issues promptly and help improve service delivery.


Key Responsibilities


	Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of client accounts, handling day-to-day queries, service requests, and escalations.
	Conduct regular site visits and quality checks across assigned locations, working alongside the QCO team to confirm service standards are met.
	Track and follow up on open issues (PPE gaps, equipment needs, staffing shortfalls) until resolved, escalating to Operations/HR where needed.
	Coordinate with site supervisors and cleaning staff to ensure schedules, staffing levels, and consumables are in order.
	Prepare client-facing service reports and internal status updates on site performance.
	Support contract renewal conversations by flagging service issues, client satisfaction signals, and scope changes ahead of renewal windows.
	Liaise with sub-contractors (e.g., specialist restoration vendors) on scoped projects at client sites, tracking deliverables and timelines.


Minimum Requirements


	HND / B.Sc in Estate Management, Facility Management, Business Administration, or any related field.
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in operations, facility management, or client relationship roles.
	Strong communication, interpersonal, and conflict-resolution skills.
	Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
	Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Familiarity with CRM or facility management software is an advantage.
	Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
	High attention to detail and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.


Salary
N180,000 &ndash; N200,000 monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: hr@begiclean.com using &quot;Operations &amp; Client Relationship Officer&quot; as the subject of the email.",
